answer_1.quote: Lexical Simplification (LS) ... replaces complex words in a context sentence with simpler alternatives.
answer_1.outputs: A single simpler alternative word for each target word in context.

answer_2.quote: we used Accuracy@1@top1 (ACC) and Potential@1 (POT) ... We also computed AUC (Beneficial vs Harmful) and B_H0.1 (Beneficial Rate at 10% Harmful).

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 100 instances per language and assigned harmfulness tags to the alternatives generated by each system.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated each generated alternative using four harmfulness tags: Grammar Error, Change of Meaning, More Difficult, and Gibberish.
